title: インダストリアルエンジニアリング
subtitle: Industrial Engineering
educationalGoal: Students understand the basic terms and methods for planning, management, and improvement in this course, and they also learn "Industrial Engineering" methods based on quantification and visualization, and improvements based on data acquisition and analysis. Industrial Engineering methods can be useful for not manufacturing industry but also many other industries.
advice:
This course deals with "Industrial Engineering (IE)" that is maximizing value while minimizing the input of resources such as people, materials, money, and information by clarifying value and waste.
Students learn the basic knowledge, principles, and methodologies of IE with a view to practical application as well as theoretical understanding through classroom lectures. The topics of this course covers so-called work studies such as time studies, motion studies, and process analysis in classical IE, improvement through standardization, statistical quality control methods, and design of experiments in modern IE. After understanding the basic knowledge and principles of these topics, students apply them to simple exercises to acquire practical skills in each classes.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic terms of industrial engineering
Be able to apply the basic methods of industrial engineering to a given simple case
Be able to acquire and visualize data for a given simple case using statistical quality control methods
Be able to apply the concept of design of experiments to a given simple case
Be able to define the problem and make a plan to improve it (kaizen)
